title: [AAFLOW+] Stateful Operator Abstraction with Zero-Copy Distributed KV Cache Orchestration for Multi-Agent Workflows
authors: Arup Kumar Sarker; Alexander James Halpern; Mills Staylor; Aymen Alsaadi; Gregor von Laszewski; Yue Cheng; Shantenu Jha; Geoffrey Fox
venue_full: arXiv preprint (PVLDB metadata in manuscript is placeholder)
affiliations: University of Virginia, Rutgers University, Princeton Plasma Physics Laboratory
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Datacenter networking, RDMA / Transport

problem_statement.en: Text-centric multi-agent workflows repeatedly replay shared context through prefill because reusable KV state is confined to local serving scope and lacks workflow-level transfer, branching, composition, placement, and lineage semantics.
problem_statement.zh: text-centric multi-agent workflow 會反覆以 prefill 重播共享 context，因為可重用 KV state 局限於 local serving scope，缺少 workflow-level transfer、branching、composition、placement 與 lineage semantics。

key_innovation.en: AAFLOW+ extends dataflow into STATEFLOW with separate data/state edges and first-class KV materialize, transfer, fork, restricted-composition, and eviction operators over state objects carrying model/configuration, token-position, positional metadata, lineage, placement, and ownership.
key_innovation.zh: AAFLOW+ 將 dataflow 延伸為 STATEFLOW，分離 data/state edge，並對記錄 model/configuration、token-position、positional metadata、lineage、placement 與 ownership 的 state object 提供第一級 KV materialize、transfer、fork、restricted-composition 與 eviction operator。

baselines_compared: Dense text passing, AAFLOW-text, vLLM prefix caching, SGLang, KVCOMM, DistServe-style

key_improvements.en: Analytical model parameterized by microbenchmarks reports up to 50.2x lower TTFT, 7.63x lower multi-agent compute cost at 16 agents, 1.72-6.10x lower KV memory, and over 7.74x throughput.
key_improvements.zh: 由 microbenchmark 參數化的 analytical model 回報 TTFT 最高降低 50.2x、16-agent compute cost 降低 7.63x、KV memory 降低 1.72–6.10x、throughput 超過 7.74x。

infra_layer: KV-cache reuse, KV communication, Control plane / interface, State fabric / offload

workloads_traces.en: Deterministic synthetic long prompts and Natural Questions in multi-agent debate, Tree-of-Thought, and RAG topologies; contexts 1K-32K, 2-16 agents, branch factor 2-16.
workloads_traces.zh: 在 multi-agent debate、Tree-of-Thought 與 RAG topology 上使用確定性 synthetic long prompts 與 Natural Questions；context 1K–32K、2–16 agents、branch factor 2–16。

key_parameters.en: Mistral context 32,640 + 64 output; Llama context 8,128 + 64 output; 4-16 nodes with A100 80 GB or 40 GB, 32-64 CPU cores, RDMA InfiniBand; main example 16 agents, branch factor 8, 32 prompts; network model 25 GB/s (200 Gbps), 50 us network, .1 ms resume, 50 us state/text framework overhead, sweep 10-400 Gbps and 10/100 us; merge only strictly non-overlapping sequential concatenation with compatibility and lineage checks. Request rate, tools, TTL, runtime cache capacity, trials, and seeds not stated; multi-agent totals are analytical, not observed wall time.
key_parameters.zh: Mistral context 32,640 + output 64；Llama context 8,128 + output 64；4–16 nodes，每節點 A100 80 GB 或 40 GB、32–64 CPU cores、RDMA InfiniBand；主要範例為 16 agents、branch factor 8、32 prompts；network model 為 25 GB/s（200 Gbps）、network 50 us、resume .1 ms、state/text framework overhead 50 us，並 sweep 10–400 Gbps 與 10/100 us；merge 僅允許在 compatibility 與 lineage check 通過時進行嚴格非重疊的 sequential concatenation。request rate、工具、TTL、runtime cache 容量、trial 與 seed 未載明；multi-agent total 為 analytical value，而非實測 wall time。

metrics_defined.en: TTFT is arrival to first output token; also aggregate compute, framework overhead, tokens/s, peak KV memory, reuse ratio, and transfer/avoided-recompute ratio. Total latency is modeled aggregate work, not job wall time.
metrics_defined.zh: TTFT 自 arrival 起至第一個 output token；另含 aggregate compute、framework overhead、tokens/s、peak KV memory、reuse ratio 與 transfer/avoided-recompute ratio。total latency 為 modeled aggregate work，並非 job wall time。

headline_vs_realistic.en: The analytical headline is up to 50.2x lower TTFT and over 7.74x throughput; against the strongest listed DistServe-style baseline, mean TTFT is 0.030 versus 0.052 s for Llama3 (about 1.73x), and end-to-end scaling remains model-derived.
headline_vs_realistic.zh: analytical headline 為 TTFT 最高降低 50.2x、throughput 超過 7.74x；相較最強的 DistServe-style baseline，Llama3 mean TTFT 為 0.030 對 0.052 s（約 1.73x），且端到端 scaling 仍由模型推導。

key_assumption_dynamic.en: AAFLOW+ assumes the declared stateflow graph and KV lineage/compatibility metadata are available; dynamic branches are safe only when represented as explicit fork/state objects, otherwise the runtime falls back to replay or recomputation.
key_assumption_dynamic.zh: AAFLOW+ 假設 declared stateflow graph 與 KV lineage/compatibility metadata 可用；dynamic branch 僅在表示為明確 fork/state object 時可安全處理，否則 runtime 退回 replay 或 recomputation。
